name: laundry-delivery-system
description: Root orchestrator for Laundry Delivery System microservices

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix api-gateway && npm install --prefix customer-service && npm install --prefix order-service && npm install --prefix pickup-delivery-service && npm install --prefix payment-service && npm install --prefix laundry-processing-service
scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,customer,order,delivery,payment,laundry -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue,white "npm run dev --prefix api-gateway" "npm run dev --prefix customer-service" "npm run dev --prefix order-service" "npm run dev --prefix pickup-delivery-service" "npm run dev --prefix payment-service" "npm run dev --prefix laundry-processing-service"
scripts.start: concurrently -n gateway,customer,order,delivery,payment,laundry -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue,white "npm run start --prefix api-gateway" "npm run start --prefix customer-service" "npm run start --prefix order-service" "npm run start --prefix pickup-delivery-service" "npm run start --prefix payment-service" "npm run start --prefix laundry-processing-service"
